 Access Health CT open enrollment begins 
 Access Health CT gives residents the opportunity to look through plans that offer lower premiums and out-of-pocket costs. By Stephannie Joseph Published : Oct. 23, 2026 at 5:03 AM EDT | Updated : seconds ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google HARTFORD, Conn. (WFSB) - Open enrollment for Access Health CT, the state’s official marketplace for Affordable Care Act coverage, opened Friday and runs through Jan. 15.
 The enrollment period applies to both first-time applicants and those renewing coverage.
 Access Health CT gives residents the opportunity to look through plans that offer lower premiums and out-of-pocket costs.
 To qualify, applicants must be Connecticut residents, U.S. citizens or legal residents, and not incarcerated.
 The Medicaid HUSKY plan has additional income requirements.
 Acceptable proofs of income include paystubs or profit and loss statements for those who are self-employed.
 Plans chosen by Dec. 15 are expected to start on Jan. 1.
